title: Knock Sensor Detection System (KSDS) - Engine Limp Home Mode
meaning: Knock Sensor Detection System (KSDS) algorithm detected abnormal high-frequency engine vibration frequencies characteristic of severe connecting rod bearing wear / clearance play (Technical Service Bulletin 21-01-052H). ECM forced vehicle into 1,800-2,000 RPM Limp-Home Mode.
symptoms: Flashing Check Engine Light (MIL)
Engine throttled to limp-home mode (max 1800-2000 RPM)
Audible bottom-end rod bearing knock under light acceleration
Loss of acceleration and passing power on highway
inspectionSteps: DO NOT clear code before documenting freeze frame data for Hyundai/Kia extended engine warranty claim (Campaign 953 / T3G).
Perform Hyundai/Kia Bearing Clearance Test (BCT) using factory SST or specialized acoustic tool.
Inspect engine oil level, oil filter condition, and check oil pan for bronze/metallic bearing glitter.
Verify knock sensor resistance and wiring harness sub-assembly near starter motor.
verifiedFixes: Complete engine short-block or long-block replacement under Hyundai/Kia extended lifetime bearing warranty
Update ECM KSDS software calibration and replace knock sensor wiring harness if bearing clearance test passes

title: Continuous Variable Valve Timing (CVVT) - Intake Cam Over-Advanced (Bank 1)
meaning: Intake camshaft timing angle has exceeded target advance threshold on Theta II / Gamma GDI engine, typically caused by sludged Oil Control Valve (OCV) or stuck camshaft phaser.
symptoms: Illuminated Check Engine Light
Rough engine idle and hesitation on cold starts
Rattling or clicking noise from front timing cover during startup
Decreased fuel economy
inspectionSteps: Check engine oil level and viscosity; low or sheared 5W-20/5W-30 oil starves CVVT phasers.
Remove and inspect Intake Oil Control Valve (OCV) spool and micro-mesh screen for carbon varnish.
Bench test OCV solenoid resistance (approx. 6.8 to 8.2 ohms) and 12V actuation.
verifiedFixes: Replace faulty Intake Camshaft Oil Control Valve (OCV)
Engine oil flush with genuine Hyundai/Kia OEM oil filter and fresh synthetic oil
Replace worn intake CVVT camshaft gear phaser assembly

title: Continuous Variable Valve Timing (CVVT) - Exhaust Cam Over-Advanced (Bank 1)
meaning: Exhaust camshaft position is more advanced than commanded by the ECM due to oil pressure starvation, sticking exhaust OCV solenoid, or timing chain elongation.
symptoms: Check Engine Light on
Engine stumbling or stalling when coming to a stop
Rough idle when warm
Pungent exhaust odor
inspectionSteps: Remove and clean Exhaust Oil Control Valve (OCV) on cylinder head.
Inspect timing chain tensioner extension and check for stretched timing chain slack.
Verify oil pressure at cylinder head port with mechanical pressure gauge.
verifiedFixes: Replace Exhaust Oil Control Valve (OCV)
Replace timing chain, tensioner arms, and hydraulic tensioner
Fresh engine oil service with OEM filter

title: EVAP System Gross Leak Detected
meaning: ECM vacuum decay monitor detected large vapor flow loss in fuel evaporative system during engine-off natural vacuum (EONV) test.
symptoms: Check Engine Light on
Fuel odor near rear quarter panel / fuel door
Occasional hard starting immediately after refueling at gas station
inspectionSteps: Inspect fuel filler cap O-ring seal for tears, cracks, or loose ratchet fit.
Inspect Canister Close Valve (CCV) vent solenoid mounted near charcoal canister above rear suspension.
Perform EVAP smoke test through engine bay service port.
verifiedFixes: Replace faulty Canister Close Valve (CCV) vent solenoid
Replace genuine fuel filler cap
Replace cracked charcoal vapor canister assembly

title: EVAP System Small Leak Detected
meaning: Evaporative emissions control system detected subtle vapor pressure bleed down (0.040 inch leak equivalent).
symptoms: Check Engine Light illuminated
No perceptible change in driveability
inspectionSteps: Clean fuel filler neck rim of corrosion and inspect cap gasket.
Test Purge Control Solenoid Valve (PCSV) under intake manifold for vacuum bleed-through when de-energized.
Smoke test vapor line running under chassis to rear canister.
verifiedFixes: Replace leaking Purge Control Solenoid Valve (PCSV)
Replace fuel filler cap gasket
Repair loose EVAP quick-disconnect vapor line coupling

title: EVAP System Very Small Leak Detected (0.020 inch)
meaning: Micro-leak detected in evaporative fuel system during precision pressure decay cycle.
symptoms: Check Engine Light on
Emissions monitor fails to set ready
inspectionSteps: Smoke test fuel vapor lines with ultrasonic leak detector.
Verify PCSV solenoid seal against manifold vacuum.
Inspect fuel tank pressure sensor (FTPS) signal stability.
verifiedFixes: Replace Purge Control Solenoid Valve (PCSV)
Replace fuel cap with OEM replacement
Replace leaking Canister Close Valve (CCV)

title: Random / Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected
meaning: Crankshaft Position Sensor detected rotational velocity deceleration irregularities across multiple cylinders on GDI engine.
symptoms: Flashing or steady Check Engine Light
Engine shudder and vibration under load or acceleration
Hesitation when passing
Raw fuel smell from exhaust tailpipe
inspectionSteps: Remove spark plugs and check for fuel fouling, oil contamination, or excessive electrode gap.
Borescope intake valves through throttle body/manifold for severe GDI carbon buildup.
Inspect direct injection high-pressure fuel rail pressure (target 40-150 bar depending on RPM).
verifiedFixes: Replace ignition coils and iridium spark plugs
Perform intake valve walnut blasting carbon decoking service
Replace failing high-pressure GDI fuel injector

title: High Pressure Fuel System - Pressure Low
meaning: High Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP) driven by camshaft lobe failed to deliver commanded rail pressure under high load.
symptoms: Check Engine Light on
Engine sputtering or going flat above 3500 RPM
Long cranking time before starting
Vehicle enters reduced power mode
inspectionSteps: Monitor live high-pressure fuel rail sensor PID during wide-open throttle test.
Remove mechanical HPFP from valve cover and inspect tappet roller follower for wear against camshaft lobe.
Test low-pressure in-tank fuel pump delivery (approx. 5-6 bar supply).
verifiedFixes: Replace mechanical High Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP)
Replace worn HPFP roller tappet follower and exhaust camshaft if scored
Replace in-tank low pressure fuel delivery pump

title: Smartra Immobilizer Transponder Key Request Error
meaning: ECM received invalid response or timeout from Smartra transponder immobilizer antenna coil during ignition key authentication.
symptoms: Engine cranks continuously but will not fire/start
Immobilizer key symbol indicator flashing on instrument cluster
Intermittent no-start condition
inspectionSteps: Check immobilizer antenna coil ring around ignition key cylinder for loose connector.
Test with second spare factory key to rule out damaged transponder chip.
Verify 12V power supply and ground to Smartra module.
verifiedFixes: Replace ignition lock cylinder antenna coil
Reprogram smart key transponder using factory diagnostic tool
Repair Smartra harness ground connection

title: Immobilizer - Unmatched Key / Transponder EEPROM Fault
meaning: Key transponder EEPROM data does not match security PIN registered in the ECM memory.
symptoms: Engine cranks with zero fuel injection / spark
Security / Key light rapidly blinking on dashboard
inspectionSteps: Scan immobilizer live data for registered key count.
Verify key battery voltage (on smart key fob push-to-start models).
Check for aftermarket remote start or RF interference near console.
verifiedFixes: Perform key re-registration and security PIN relearn
Replace damaged key fob transponder chip
Replace Smartra control unit

title: Wheel Speed Sensor Front-Left Circuit Open / Short
meaning: ABS/ESC control module detected electrical open circuit or ground short in the Front-Left active Hall-effect wheel speed sensor circuit.
symptoms: Illuminated ABS, ESC / Traction Control, and Auto-Hold warning lights
Speedometer erratic or Cruise Control disabled
ABS braking disabled during hard stops
inspectionSteps: Inspect wheel speed sensor pigtail harness inside front fender liner for tire rub damage or corrosion.
Measure DC supply voltage from ABS module at sensor connector (approx. 11-12V).
Inspect magnetic encoder ring integrated into wheel hub bearing for debris or rust cracks.
verifiedFixes: Replace Front-Left ABS wheel speed sensor assembly
Repair chafed wiring harness in wheel well
Replace front wheel hub bearing assembly with integrated encoder

title: Wheel Speed Sensor Front-Right Circuit Open / Short
meaning: ABS control unit detected broken circuit or signal loss from the Front-Right wheel speed sensor.
symptoms: ABS and Traction Control lights illuminated
Inoperative cruise control
Electronic stability control disabled
inspectionSteps: Check harness connector at right strut tower for water intrusion.
Inspect sensor tip for metal shavings and inspect tone ring teeth/magnetic seal.
verifiedFixes: Replace Front-Right wheel speed sensor
Clean magnetic encoder ring on hub bearing

title: Wheel Speed Sensor Rear-Left Circuit Open / Short
meaning: Rear-Left wheel speed sensor electrical circuit fault detected by ABS ECU.
symptoms: ABS and ESC warning lights illuminated
Electric parking brake (EPB) warning light illuminated
inspectionSteps: Inspect sensor harness routing along rear trailing arm.
Check connector pins for green corrosion.
verifiedFixes: Replace Rear-Left ABS sensor
Repair broken wiring near rear suspension pivot

title: Wheel Speed Sensor Rear-Right Circuit Open / Short
meaning: Rear-Right wheel speed sensor circuit open or shorted to ground.
symptoms: ABS and Traction Control lights on
All-Wheel Drive (AWD) lock warning indicator illuminated
inspectionSteps: Inspect rear right axle sensor harness connector.
Measure sensor circuit resistance and check signal waveform.
verifiedFixes: Replace Rear-Right wheel speed sensor
Replace rear wheel bearing hub assembly

title: Motor Driven Power Steering (MDPS) - Torque Sensor Error
meaning: Electronic Power Steering (MDPS) ECU detected abnormal voltage differential across steering column optical/magnetic torque sensor coils.
symptoms: Steering wheel icon warning light illuminated on cluster
Heavy manual steering effort (power assist abruptly cut)
Notchy or clicking feeling when turning steering wheel
inspectionSteps: Perform MDPS ASP (Absolute Steering Position) calibration zero-point relearn.
Inspect steering column flexible rubber coupling (star coupler) for disintegration/slop.
Check torque sensor harness connector under lower dash panel.
verifiedFixes: Calibrate Absolute Steering Position (ASP) with diagnostic tool
Replace steering column flexible rubber coupler (Service Campaign 14-ST-002)
Replace steering column MDPS torque sensor assembly

title: CAN Communication Timeout with Engine Control Module
meaning: Chassis/ABS/MDPS controller lost CAN bus message frames from the Engine Control Module (ECM) within timeout window.
symptoms: Multiple dashboard warning lights (ABS, ESC, Steering, Check Engine)
Transmission shifts harshly into default 4th gear gear lock
Erratic speedometer and tachometer display
inspectionSteps: Measure CAN High (pin 6) and CAN Low (pin 14) resistance at OBD connector with battery disconnected (target 60 ohms).
Check main powertrain harness bulkhead connector on firewall for loose locking tab.
Verify ECM ground eyelets on engine block and transmission case.
verifiedFixes: Clean and tighten engine main chassis ground straps
Repair damaged CAN bus twisted pair wiring in engine bay harness
Replace failed Engine Control Module

title: CAN Bus Off - High Speed CAN Controller Error
meaning: Chassis communication CAN controller entered 'Bus Off' state due to excessive transmit/receive error counts caused by physical line short or corrupt transceiver.
symptoms: Vehicle fails to shift out of park or enters limp mode
Multiple system warnings on cluster
Scanner unable to communicate with multiple modules
inspectionSteps: Disconnect modules sequentially while monitoring CAN bus resistance.
Check front bumper wiring harness for water intrusion or accident damage.
Inspect joint connector blocks under driver kick panel.
verifiedFixes: Locate and repair shorted CAN High / CAN Low wires
Replace module with internally shorted CAN transceiver

title: Driver Airbag Resistance High (1st Stage) - Clockspring Failure
meaning: SRS Airbag Control Module detected squib circuit resistance exceeding 3.5 ohms in the driver's steering wheel airbag circuit, typically caused by broken ribbon tape in the clockspring.
symptoms: Airbag warning light illuminated constantly
Steering wheel horn or cruise control buttons intermittently inoperative
Audible rubbing or clicking noise when rotating steering wheel
inspectionSteps: DISCONNECT BATTERY AND WAIT 5 MINUTES before servicing steering wheel SRS system.
Measure clockspring ribbon continuity while turning steering wheel lock-to-lock.
Inspect yellow SRS squib connector behind airbag module.
verifiedFixes: Replace steering column Clockspring assembly (contact coil)
Repair damaged steering column airbag sub-harness connector

title: Occupant Classification System (OCS) - Sensor Mat Fault
meaning: SRS Airbag module detected calibration or sensor circuit error in the front passenger seat Occupant Classification System (OCS) pressure mat.
symptoms: Airbag warning light on
'Passenger Airbag OFF' light remains illuminated even with adult seated
Seatbelt reminder chime behaves erratically
inspectionSteps: Check for foreign metal objects or liquid spills under front passenger seat cushion.
Perform OCS zero-point calibration and passenger weight sensor reset using scan tool.
Check yellow under-seat wiring harness for strain when seat is adjusted forward/backward.
verifiedFixes: Perform OCS calibration zero-point reset procedure
Replace front passenger seat cushion with integrated OCS pressure mat
Reconnect or repair under-seat SRS harness connector

title: Battery Voltage Low - Body Control Module
meaning: Body Control Module (BCM) detected main battery line voltage dropped below 9.0V during operation.
symptoms: Slow engine cranking on cold mornings
Flickering interior or ambient lighting
Radio or smart key proximity features temporarily disabled
inspectionSteps: Test 12V battery State of Health (SOH) and Cold Cranking Amps (CCA) with digital battery analyzer.
Test alternator output voltage under high electrical load (target 13.8V - 14.5V).
Inspect battery terminal clamps for acid corrosion or loose fit.
verifiedFixes: Replace aged 12V starter battery (AGM/Flooded)
Clean and tighten battery terminal posts and ground connection
Replace failing alternator or voltage regulator

title: Lost Communication with Engine Control Module (ECM/PCM)
meaning: CAN network supervisory controller timed out waiting for heartbeat packets from the primary Engine Control Module.
symptoms: Engine will not crank or start
Check Engine, ABS, and Transmission warning lights on
Cooling fans running at maximum continuous speed
Shift lever locked in Park
inspectionSteps: Check main ECM fuse and main power relay in engine bay junction box (E-box).
Verify ignition switched 12V power and chassis ground at ECM harness connector.
Inspect wiring harness along driver side shock tower for rodent gnawing.
verifiedFixes: Replace blown ECM power fuse or faulty main engine relay
Repair damaged power feed or ground wire to ECM
Replace failed Engine Control Module

title: Lost Communication with Transmission Control Module (TCM)
meaning: ECM and cluster lost CAN communication frames from the Transmission Control Module.
symptoms: Transmission locked in 4th gear limp mode
Gear position indicator display on cluster is blank or dashes (--)
Hard clunk when shifting into Reverse or Drive
inspectionSteps: Check TCM power fuses and TCM relay.
Inspect TCM multi-pin harness connector on transmission case for fluid intrusion.
Verify CAN High and CAN Low integrity to TCM.
verifiedFixes: Replace blown TCM fuse
Clean and reseal TCM connector pins
Replace Transmission Control Module
